group_norms.norm_text: We share work-in-progress images for critique without filtering them first
We respect that beginner questions are welcome in main chat
We prefer narrowband palettes for emission nebulae
We treat dark-site road trips as the social high point of the season
We use AI-based image enhancement tools (BlurXTerminator, NoiseXTerminator) routinely
